verses.t: Of course you could hardly call such old scarecrows temptations. But still----

(THE GREAT PIANIST comes to the last measure of the coda--_a passage of almost Haydnesque clarity and spirit. As he strikes the broad chord of the tonic there comes a roar of applause. He arises, moves a step or two down the stage, and makes a series of low bows, his hands to his heart._)
